text:
Aria (AE): @channel FYI we just received Cedent's RFI — they want a POC that demonstrates on-prem inference + KMS integration. Deadline for the written response is end of week.
Sam (SE): Thanks. Do they need full air-gapped install or VPC with private endpoints?
Nora (Customer Success): They said air-gapped ideally, but will accept VPC-peered Private if on-prem isn't possible before pilot.
Mike (Solutions Eng): For an initial POC we can do private deployment (VPC) in their cloud region and provide a limited on-prem demo via an appliance image. Will need SOW for infra + SE hours.
Aria (AE): Pricing question from procurement: can we split POC cost into "platform" + "SE" line items? They prefer line-itemized quotes.
Sam (SE): Yes. Suggest: platform reserved capacity for pilot (monthly) + one-time SE professional services. I can draft numbers.
Lina (Security PM): Quick security Qs to answer in the RFI: KMS/HSM support, data residency, separation of telemetry, SOC2/FedRAMP posture, and whether Customer-managed KMS keys are supported for Private.
Sam (SE): KMS: we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault for Private; HSM via BYO-HSM with PKCS#11 adapters in the on-prem package. I'll add details.
Nora (Customer Success): Also add rollback/upgrade guardrails for the Private control plane — Cedent asked about upgrade windows and change freeze during POC.
Mike (Solutions Eng): Noted. We should include canary deploy instructions and a suggested rollback command snippet: `rdmctl deploy rollback --version <prev>`
Aria (AE): Cedent asked for a capability matrix mapping their checklist (embedding latency, token throughput, data retention, key mgmt). Can someone map our features to their columns?
Sam (SE): I'll take throughput/latency + model variants. Mike can cover deployment topology and HA. Lina covers security/compliance rows.
Lina (Security PM): For the compliance column: we have SOC2 Type II, periodic pen tests, and we can provide a SOC2 report under NDA. For FedRAMP, we do not have an authorized offering but we can provide controls mapping.
Mike (Solutions Eng): For the deployment topology row, I'll attach a diagram. Link: https://redwood-internal.s3/attachments/cedent-poc-topology-v1.png
Aria (AE): Procurement also needs standard contract terms: liability cap, data processing addendum, and export control language. Legal asked to review but want high-level answers in the RFI.
Nora (Customer Success): I'll add a brief DPA + export controls note and flag Legal for sign-off.
Sam (SE): Two technical blockers Cedent mentioned: (1) their inference workload needs ~2M tokens/day with 99th percentile latency < 150ms, (2) they use a custom tokenizer for legacy data. Thoughts?
Mike (Solutions Eng): 2M tokens/day is fine on Dedicated with autoscale — but the 99th p <150ms depends on model size and batch config. Recommend using a quantized variant and shard routes per region. I can run a quick perf calc and share numbers.
Sam (SE): For the custom tokenizer we can: (a) add tokenizer to model bundle and host, (b) pre-tokenize before sending to API. Pre-tokenize is fastest to integrate for POC. Document both options in the RFI.
Aria (AE): Great. Can we indicate estimated POC cost ranges in the RFI? Cedent expects a ballpark.
Mike (Solutions Eng): Rough estimate: Private pilot (1 month) — infra reserved: $18k-$30k depending on GPU type + SE: $12k one-time. I'll provide low/medium/high scenarios.
Lina (Security PM): Add an SLA note: Pilot doesn't carry full production SLA; mention Dedicated SLA tiers for production and optional premium support add-on.
rfi-bot: Document uploaded: https://drive.redwood/cedent/rfi_answers_4287654321.pdf (requires redwood SSO).
Aria (AE): Thanks everyone. Action items: Sam — draft capability matrix and latency/throughput bullets. Mike — perf calc + topology diagram. Lina — security answers + SOC2 NDA note. Nora — DPA/export language and procurement line items. I'll assemble and send to Cedent by Fri EOD. :thumbsup:
Sam (SE): Got it, I'll post the matrix in this thread by tomorrow AM.
Mike (Solutions Eng): Will run perf sims tonight and post numbers.
Lina (Security PM): I'll attach the SOC2 checklist and KMS integration docs.
Nora (Customer Success): Looping legal now.
Aria (AE): If anyone gets blocking questions from Cedent directly, ping me. Closing the loop here — thanks! :sparkles:
